{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md <<'EOF'
# TaggedCache handoff (milestone 3 complete)

Implementation: src/cachetools/tagged.py (TaggedCache over cachetools.LRUCache).
Tests: tests/test_tagged.py (own), acceptance_public.py (public, unchanged), tests/* upstream (unchanged).

## Status: all milestones implemented and verified
- R01: put/get with deep copies both ways, tag validation (no bare str/bytes, no non-str entries), dedup, ValueError before mutation.
- R02: invalidate(tag) exact removal + count; replacement swaps tag memberships; eviction prunes memberships via _TaggedLRUCache._evicted; get refreshes LRU; len counts live. Put on existing key refreshes recency (Claim-A ext).
- R03: maxsize positive int excluding bool; invalid replacement leaves value/tags/recency/expiry unchanged; one slot per value.
- R04: invalidate_many(tags, mode='any'|'all'); any=union, all=intersection; empty tags -> 0; invalid mode/tags raise before mutation; returns distinct keys removed.
- R05: resize validates positive non-bool int first; shrink evicts LRU-first, grow never evicts; survivors keep values/tags/LRU order AND absolute expiries (Claim-A round 2: expiry stored per-key in __expiry, never recomputed); failed resize preserves all state; maxsize property.
- R06: generator tags consumed exactly once; nested deep-copy detachment across repeated gets/puts.
- R07: TaggedCache(maxsize, timer=None) default time.monotonic; put(..., ttl=None); None=immortal; finite nonnegative int/float (bool excluded, inf/nan rejected) sets absolute expiry timer()+ttl; invalid ttl ValueError before mutation; ttl=0 immediately expired; exact boundary (now >= expiry) is expired.
- R08: __purge_expired() runs at start of get/put/len/resize/invalidate/invalidate_many/pop; purge deletes expired entries without touching survivors' recency (no __update calls); overwrite replaces prior expiry; invalidation counts only live; expired/missing get raises KeyError; timer/ttl optional so old callers unchanged.

## Verified (run with PYTHONPATH=src:.)
- tests/ (313 upstream+own) + acceptance_public.py (4) = 317 passed.
- Extra TTL edge checks in /tmp/test_ttl_extra.py (20 tests) passed: boundary expiry, ttl=0, invalid ttl values (-1, True, '5', nan, inf, list, object), overwrite replaces expiry, purge before len/put/resize/invalidate, resize preserves absolute expiry, key reuse after expiry has no stale tags, timer not required without ttl.
EOF
wc -l HANDOFF.md"}
